relations.label: BECAUSE
relations.comment: RAGTree-normalized CausalBank reverse causal-context family: an effect/result is explained by a cause/reason. The normalized lexical graph is dense and may contain bidirectional lexical associations within a record.

relations.label: THEREFORE
relations.comment: RAGTree-normalized CausalBank forward causal-context family: a cause/reason leads to an effect/result. The normalized lexical graph is dense and may contain bidirectional lexical associations within a record.
